prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling school science fair. On the left, a girl with braided hair leans forward intently, her eyes fixed on a bubbling blue liquid inside a glass beaker. Next to her stands a boy in a striped shirt, who is pointing a finger at the swirling mixture while explaining the chemical reaction. In the center, a teacher with silver glasses observes the experiment closely, holding a clipboard against her chest. To the right of the teacher, a small white rabbit sits calmly on a wooden table, its nose twitching slightly as it watches the activity. Beside the rabbit, a potted fern with lush green leaves adds a touch of nature to the scientific display. Behind the group, a janitor in a blue uniform sweeps the floor, pushing a broom across the tiled surface. There is no digital screen or computer monitor visible in the scene, emphasizing the hands-on nature of the projects. The girl with braided hair rests her hand on the table edge, stabilizing herself as she peers into the beaker. The boy in the striped shirt gestures animatedly, his mouth open mid-sentence. The teacher with silver glasses nods slightly, acknowledging the students' effort. The small white rabbit remains still, contrasting with the dynamic human interactions. The potted fern stands tall, its leaves casting soft shadows on the table. The janitor in the blue uniform works diligently in the background, ensuring the area remains clean. The composition balances the focused foreground activity with the subtle background maintenance, creating a lively yet organized atmosphere typical of an educational event.
